critical.diagnostic_policy: historical archive only; never use for threshold or inference

mass.identity: For ds²=-alpha² dt²+a² dr²+r²dOmega², Phi=partial_r phi, Pi=(a/alpha)partial_t phi, m=r(1-a^-2)/2, m_t=4*pi*r²*alpha*Phi*Pi/a³; positive means inward mass increase. Check m(t,r)-m(0,r)-integral F_in dt, normalized by initial DOMAIN mass M0; independent time equation not radial geometry solve. Not independent numerical solver.
mass.boundary: linear extrapolation Phi,Pi from two outermost centers to R; a(R)=(1-2M/R)^-1/2 and alpha(R)=1/a(R) match solver outer lapse; signed flux not set to zero by assumption
mass.interior: linear interpolation of m and field-derived flux at fixed areal radii; never use m differences to infer flux
mass.quadrature: trapezoid each accepted integration step; max over every recorded time and all fixed radii plus outer face; local instantaneous L2 optional diagnostic, normalized by flux energy; report signed accumulated flux and residual separately
mass.controls: analytic constant inward/outward flux and injected imbalance; physical noncritical control, interior sphere crossing tested; outer boundary near vacuum in actual cases, nontrivial outgoing-boundary test not claimed

convergence.time: central proper time trapezoid alpha[0] as R4B0; report alternative 2-cell even lapse extrapolation as diagnostic only
convergence.common_support: 0 to minimum final proper time across all three; no time shift, no fitted peak alignment; all comparisons use identical 32769 uniformly spaced points
convergence.norm: L2 and Linfinity normalized by finer-grid norm for each pair; observed order uses unnormalized L2 differences on same support and sample grid; no Richardson extrapolation
convergence.local_rule: all three inference grids must meet minimum over full trace; both 2-cell and 3-cell estimators required; report common resolved mask fraction and norms separately, never substitute masked result for full-window test
convergence.interpretation: engineering criteria only; 3072/6144 already below 8; expected resolution HOLD even if finest resolves. No dropping grids after seeing results. Diagnostic observed order is not proven asymptotic order.

adaptive.rule: four consecutive nonoverlapping windows ending at checkpoint; no previous near trapping; raw class dispersal; drift and flux residual <1%; actual early run and full identical checkpoint schedule, verify prefix and full class; no threshold change; compare step counts and drift, no generalization from one case
